previous_story: Tariq welded ships sixty meters under the North Sea. Every night, a green laser pierced the dark water from Maya’s lighthouse above, flashing Morse code: *I SEE YOU.* Tonight, Tariq aimed his torch upward, burning a glowing heart into the hull. Above, Maya gasped as her sonar lit up with his response. Then, Tariq’s oxygen line snapped, plunging him into darkness. Come back for the next part tomorrow.
